components.css: :root{--green-dark:#558f6e;--green-ink:#3e7356;--green-btn:#487a5e;--green-btn-hover:#3d6b51;--green-mint:#9af7af;--clay:#e2725b;--clay-btn:#b8513b;--ink:#1b1c1c;--ink-soft:#3f4940;--paper-2:#efeded;--paper-3:#f8f9f8;--line:#becabd;--dark:#2c3333;--footer-bg:#25352c;--radius-lg:32px;--radius-pill:9999px;--shadow-soft:0 20px 60px rgb(27 28 28 / 0.1);--shadow-strong:0 30px 80px rgb(27 28 28 / 0.22);--ease-smooth:cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);}.ds-btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:15px 28px;border-radius:9999px;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable','Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;line-height:1.2;border:2px solid transparent;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),box-shadow .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),background-color .2s,color .2s;}.ds-btn::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 30%,rgb(255 255 255 / .25) 50%,transparent 70%);transform:translateX(-120%);transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);pointer-events:none;}.ds-btn:hover::before{transform:translateX(120%);}.ds-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgb(27 28 28 / .15);}.ds-btn:active{transform:scale(.97);}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #558f6e;outline-offset:2px;}.ds-btn svg{transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);}.ds-btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px);}.ds-btn-primary{background:#487a5e;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#3d6b51;}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:36px;padding:28px 32px;background:rgb(255 255 255 / .85);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid rgb(27 28 28 / .06);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable','Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;}.ds-nav a{position:relative;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;color:#3f4940;text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s;}.ds-nav a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-6px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:#558f6e;transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:#3e7356;}.ds-nav a:hover::after,.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]::after{transform:scaleX(1);}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #558f6e;outline-offset:2px;}

narrative.overview:
Kaik Home sells homes that are still being built, so the system keeps the building in view and gets everything else out of its way. Real renders and photographs of Toledo fill large, softly rounded frames. One confident green says "this is us, act here." The rest is white and near-white paper, dark ink and generous air. The tone is friendly and local, the sort of developer that answers the phone, and it never reads as luxury or as a corporate portal.

This build refines the incumbent identity of the original PHP site (`legacy/css/styles.css`). Typeface, palette, pill badges, 32px cards, the dark contact panel and the forest footer all carry over unchanged. The modernization layer is motion only: a self-hosted variable font, a staggered hero entrance, fade-up reveals, Lenis smooth scrolling, a crossfading and pushing-in home hero, Ken Burns and parallax on development heroes, a header that compacts, cards that lift, a shine sweep across buttons, pulsing status dots, and a view transition from a development card into its hero. Every motion has a reduced-motion fallback, and content never depends on JavaScript to become visible.

Density is low to medium. A page is a series of full-width bands that alternate white with paper. Each band has a single left-aligned section head, then a two- or three-up grid of large cards.
keyCharacteristics: Plus Jakarta Sans throughout, extra-bold (800) headings with tight tracking, regular body in a soft green-grey ink.
One brand green carries every action; mint and clay appear only as status and highlight.
Large 32px-radius image cards with soft, wide, low-opacity shadows that deepen on hover.
Pill shapes for every button, badge, chip and status marker.
A dark charcoal contact panel with a drifting mint glow sits opposite a light form; a deep forest-green footer closes the page.
Motion is eased with one curve (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`) and always degrades to static.

rules.name: The Two-Greens Rule
rules.body: White text never sits on Kaik Garden Green. It sits on Button Green (or Deep Button Green on hover). Small green text on white uses Green Ink. Kaik Garden Green itself is for strokes, icons, focus and large display words.

rules.name: The Status-Only Accents Rule
rules.body: Mint and clay are for status and highlight (badges, dots, labels, glow, selection). Never use them as a primary action color. Clay exists for "obra en curso" and for errors.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Face Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Plus Jakarta Sans weight and size. Headings are 800 with negative tracking. Never introduce a second display face or a serif.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards rest on Soft and, on hover, rise 6px to Strong while the image inside zooms slowly (1.05–1.06 over 0.7s). Buttons rise 2px. Nothing lifts without being clickable.

dos: **Do** put white text only on Button Green (#487a5e), Deep Button Green (#3d6b51), Burnt Clay (#b8513b), Charcoal or Forest Footer. Use Green Ink (#3e7356) for small green text on white.
**Do** use the 32px radius for every card-scale surface and the pill radius for every button, badge and chip.
**Do** keep shadows ink-tinted and wide: Soft at rest, Strong on hover or for overlays.
**Do** ease all motion with `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`. Keep content visible without JS (`html.js .reveal`) and switch motion off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** alternate white and paper bands, with one left-aligned section head (max 640px) per band.
**Do** draw icons as 2px-stroke line SVGs on a 24px grid.
donts: **Don't** put white text on Kaik Garden Green (#558f6e) or on Clay (#e2725b). Neither passes AA at button sizes.
**Don't** use mint or clay as an action color. They mark status and highlight only.
**Don't** add a second typeface or drop headings below weight 800.
**Don't** use black or colored shadows, or hard offset shadows.
**Don't** use sharp corners on cards, buttons or fields.
